=== LINKEDIN ANALYSIS ===

LinkedIn Profile Analysis: Sarah Chen has been the Head of FP&A at Meridian Logistics for 3 years, managing a team of 4 financial analysts. Prior to this, she was a Senior Financial Analyst at Linfox Logistics for 4 years, showcasing strong tenure and deep domain expertise in transport and supply chain planning workflows.

=== COMPANY OVERVIEW ===

Company Overview: Meridian Logistics is a leading third-party logistics provider in APAC, operating complex supply chain networks. They are experiencing rapid scaling, which places significant transaction volume demands on their internal corporate reporting systems.

=== OCTANE SERVICES ===

Relevant Octane Services: Octane's TM1 managed support services can optimize their existing models, while the DataFusion Connector can directly link their NetSuite actuals to a central Planning Analytics database.

=== OCTANE COMPETITORS ===

Key Competitors: They may be evaluating other enterprise performance management (EPM) systems such as Workday Adaptive Planning or Anaplan.

=== COMPETING APPLICATIONS ===

Competing Applications: Their current planning workflow relies on 35 manual Excel spreadsheets consolidated across departmental managers, creating substantial version control risks.

=== COMPLEMENTARY APPLICATIONS ===

Complementary Applications: They currently run NetSuite as their primary ERP system and use Power BI and Excel PAX for corporate executive management reporting.

=== TM1 AND AI APPLICATIONS ===

Planning Applications: Logistics planning models require multi-dimensional cost allocations by business units, routes, and payroll groups, making IBM TM1 a perfect fit.

=== RELEVANCE ASSESSMENT ===

Relevance Assessment: High. Meridian Logistics matches the profile of a Mid-Size TM1 Shop (100M+ AUD revenue, 20 in finance), making them ideal for Octane Blue Support.

=== PAIN POINTS ===

Likely Pain Points: Manual data transfers from NetSuite to Excel take 45 minutes per sheet (exceeding several days in total close time), leading to formula errors and delayed reporting cycles.

=== CONVERSATION STARTERS ===

Conversation Starters: Introduce Octane's NetSuite DataFusion connector that automates actuals loading, ask how the 35 Excel spreadsheets affect their forecasting cycles, or suggest a 60-day trial to eliminate their 45-minute manual sheet reconciliation bottleneck.

=== CUSTOMER PROFILES ===

Octane Customer Profile: Matches Mid Size TM1 Shops / MidMarket AI in Finance. The prospect has $100M+ revenue, 20 finance users, and significant spreadsheet dependency (35 spreadsheets), but wants to modernise their FP&A processes with automation, aligning with Octane's core mid-market support and AI options.

=== TRAVEL DISTANCE === ~45 min from Amendra's location (Richmond, Melbourne, VIC 3121)
